content.title: Williams-Sonoma, Designer Brands, Shoe Carnival, Sally Beauty, and Tilly's Shares Plummet, What You Need To Know
content.summary: A number of stocks fell in the afternoon session after a confluence of negative economic data pointed to a weak economy. The latest Survey of Consumer Expectations from the New York Fed revealed that households' short-term inflation expectations are rising, while their outlook on the labor market is deteriorating. Consumers expressed greater concern about potential job losses and expect lower earnings growth, factors that directly impact discretionary spending.
